problem.description: Downloaded model could still be one byte if the remote server declared Content-Length: 1
symptoms: A cached one-byte model could match remote size metadata

hypotheses.description: Content-Length equality alone does not establish model-file validity

findings: A model-format file smaller than 1024 bytes is invalid even if HTTP metadata reports the same size.

resolution.root_cause: Remote size was treated as sufficient evidence of a usable model
resolution.fix_applied: Require a minimum size for model-format files in both cache and completed download paths; keep SHA-256 and atomic replacement checks
resolution.verification: One-byte server fixture rejected; local HTTP model and offline sidecar reuse pass
